properties.description:
crates/reflow2-core/tests/prohibition_in_prose.rs — 11 tests.

POSITIVES (all 5 fail when the sweep call is disabled): a "must never" inside a requirement raises one finding with numerator, denominator and the matched phrase in its evidence; three prohibitions are ONE finding; a Constraint that binds the node clears it; a proposed Decision's musing is not scanned but the same sentence IS once the decision is accepted; matching is case-insensitive.

EXCLUSIONS (all 5 fail when every exclusion is widened at once): "shall not" is the requirement idiom and is not matched; a DesignRule and a Constraint are the homes and are not flagged; records and checks (Verification, TemporalFact) are not intent; a prohibition quoted in a rationale is reasoning; a Constraint binding the node clears it.

SILENCE TESTS that cannot fail by construction, and say so: a parked node is skipped; nothing to scan is silence, not "0 of 0".
properties.name: The prohibition detector's eleven tests, falsified in both directions
